New kinematic configs.question: Which specific configurations should Phase 21 add?
New kinematic configs.answer: All four: prismatic-only chain, mixed revolute+prismatic, 10+ DOF serial chain, 6-DOF industrial arm inspired by UR5 geometry

New kinematic configs.question: What naming convention should the model factory functions use?
How should the new configuration headers be organized in tests/test-models/chains/?
New kinematic configs.answer: Separate headers per type (e.g., chains/prismatic.h, chains/mixed.h, chains/high_dof.h, chains/industrial.h)

New kinematic configs.question: What parameter values should the new configurations use?
New kinematic configs.answer: Real specs where available (UR5 datasheet, academic papers); abstract chains use reasonable engineering values (0.5-5 kg range)
